description: Election Commission - Declare that H. G. A. Indrawansa as a member of the Namaloya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Namaloya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination procedure and the formal declaration of a new member. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically covering candidate nominations and declarations as outlined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes and related matters.
